summary: Cameco Corp filed a Form 6-K containing its second-quarter 2026 financial results, MD&A, financial statements, and CEO/CFO certifications. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer; it discusses operational and market updates, uranium production, contracting discipline, and strategic positioning, including recent ownership increase in Cigar Lake Mine and nuclear policy support. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender, or restructuring is announced. The filing is purely informational and forward-looking commentary on business performance, with no deal terms or shareholder actions requiring classification.
